definitions: A multinational technology company incorporated in Delaware and based in Santa Clara, California. It is a leading designer of graphics processing units (GPUs) for the gaming and professional markets, as well as system on a chip units (SoCs) for the mobile computing and automotive markets.
A brand of graphics processing units (GPUs) produced by Nvidia Corporation, widely used in personal computers for gaming, professional visualization, and artificial intelligence applications.
examples: Many gamers prefer Nvidia graphics cards for their performance.
Nvidia's stock has seen significant growth due to AI advancements.
The new laptop features an Nvidia GeForce RTX GPU.
